ocr_text:
14:42, Hôm nay
DOI TRUY THU NO TB: Ho so
vay, tra gop cua ong/ba
da duoc chung toi
tiep nhan. Hen ong/ba, nguoi
than 9H sang 25.7.2026 co mat
tai nha de lam viec voi ben Cty,
yeu cau khong roi khoi noi cu
tru, chuan bi day du CCCD de
xac minh khoan vay hoac TT
tien ky truoc 16H hom nay neu
muon hoa giai ! Lien he thong
bao truoc.
